title.narrative: Overall, three out of five key interventions have progressed as planned.;Development of National Inclusive Education Action Plan has been completed, with the official launch in June. However, local life skill education implementation has been delayed due to the delays in the harmonization of materials and the training manual under KAPE partnership. Delay of China fund in the system has also caused constraints in procuring pre-positioning supplies for emergency prone provinces.
